name: Lysine riboswitch bound to L-lysine
notes: Lysine riboswitch (L-box class) from Thermatoga maritima at 2.80 Å. LYS is L-lysine (MW 146, charged amino acid). No aromatic rings → no stacking. Lysine amino/carboxylate groups contact backbone P and Mg²⁺ via electrostatics. IRI (iridium hexamine phasing agent) stripped. Tests phosphate electrostatic term for non-aromatic charged ligands. Ref: Serganov et al. 2008 Cell.
enrichmentNote: Enrichment AUC 0.22 — Vina inverted. Lysine amino acid actives score worse than amino acid/aromatic decoys because Vina Gaussian terms cannot capture the H-bond cage geometry (G111 carboxylate contacts, G77 phosphate ε-amino contacts). Same fundamental inversion as SAM. Gnina CNN rescoring would partially correct; explicit electrostatics needed for full fix.
